Post-rebase CI evidence for head `7b02345a4e9138710d72db7c42eb01a61ba58946` / base `f82d2adf404b25dd83b3b56672b28141c4bb4483`:

- `9709-campaign-a-parent-close-contract-tests`: exit 127, bare `pytest: command not found`.

Clean-main reproduction on exact `origin/main=f82d2adf404b25dd83b3b56672b28141c4bb4483`:

Therefore these are independently reproduced main/infrastructure failures, not storage assertions introduced by this PR. Per scope, no shared workflow change is made here.
